fieldValues.title: What makes a relationship strong?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised as an open question in Research (3. Confidence instead of a gate), 2026-10-30, and turned into an exercise so options are explored before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Its type: evidences counts more than relates-to.
- B. Its source: the owner's words, a measurement, an agent's observation.
- C. Agreement: how many independent sources point the same way.
- D. A mix of these, fading with age.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Cases where the owner trusts or distrusts a record, and which signals explain it.
fieldValues.next_action: Take ten records the owner trusts and ten they doubt and list the relations each has.
